overview.zh: 监管与治理压力同时收紧：破产中的AI用户数据、被指违规的交易所与遭质疑的上市加密储备公司，成为今日主线。 AI数据监管：纽约州总检察长与40位跨党派州总检察长就 Character.AI 破产案提交利害关系通知，要求对可能被出售的消费者数据施加保护。 加密：SkyAI 近期大额抛售 SOL，大股东 Bastion Trading 质疑要约收购并要求全面披露 AI：Science Corporation 为首位 Stargardt 病患者植入其恢复视力的芯片

title.zh: 既然 Character.AI 正在破产，其所有用户的数据将何去何从？
title.en: Now that Character.AI is going bankrupt, what happens to all of its users’ data?

summary.zh:
纽约州总检察长 Letitia James 披露了一项针对 Character.AI 的、持续数年的多州联合调查，并与 40 位跨党派州总检察长共同在该公司的破产案中提交了「利害关系通知」（notice of interest）。该申请旨在要求对可能通过破产程序被出售的消费者数据施加保护措施。

40 位跨党派州总检察长的联合行动，使一家大型消费级 AI 平台的用户数据出售进入监管视野，表明各州当局有意在破产程序中对此类数据的转移方式施加影响。

据来源报道，该利害关系通知意在「让所有相关方注意到」所涉的监管问题；这属于一份通知性文件，而非法院裁决，也不构成对任何出售条款的批准。
summary.en:
New York Attorney General Letitia James revealed a years-long multi-state investigation into Character.AI and joined 40 bipartisan state attorneys general in filing a notice of interest in the company's bankruptcy case. The filing seeks to require protections for consumer data that may be sold through the bankruptcy proceeding.

The coordinated action by 40 bipartisan state attorneys general puts the sale of a major consumer AI platform's user data under regulatory scrutiny, signaling that state authorities intend to have a say in how such data is transferred in insolvency.

According to the source, the notice of interest is intended "to put all parties on notice of the regulatory issues" involved; it is a notice filing rather than a court ruling or an approval of any sale terms.

title.zh: 菲律宾最大加密货币交易所 Coins.ph 据称面临央行监管行动
title.en: Largest Philippines crypto exchange, Coins.ph, said to face central bank regulatory action

summary.zh:
据两位知情人士透露，拥有超过1800万用户的菲律宾最大加密货币交易所 Coins.ph 据称正面临该国央行——菲律宾中央银行（BSP）的惩罚性行动，事由是指控其服务于受限制的离岸赌博运营商。其中一位人士表示，相关违规行为的严重程度足以让这家成立12年的公司被吊销经营牌照；据称本月初 BSP 已对通过 Coins.ph 主要钱包公司 DCPay Philippines 进行的存款施加了限制。

其中一位消息人士称，鉴于 Coins.ph 的体量，一旦被吊销牌照将对菲律宾加密货币生态造成“地震级”冲击。Coins.ph 回应称用户资金安全，公司仍是 BSP 持牌机构，并预计很快全面恢复受影响的服务。

一位人士称，此次存款限制据称没有期限，且未给出理由，这与通常因吞吐量或延迟不达标而施加的临时暂停不同。Coins.ph 表示“坚决否认任何关于其明知故犯地为离岸博彩或赌博运营商提供服务的说法”，并称公司遵守 BSP、反洗钱委员会（AMLC）等监管机构的要求与标准；BSP 尚未回应置评请求。
summary.en:
Coins.ph, the largest crypto exchange in the Philippines with over 18 million customers, is reportedly facing punitive action from the country's central bank, Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), over alleged servicing of restricted offshore gambling operators, according to two people with knowledge of the situation. One of those people said the infractions are serious enough that the 12-year-old company could be stripped of its license to operate, and at the start of this month the BSP reportedly imposed restrictions on deposits made through Coins.ph's main wallet firm, DCPay Philippines.

One of the people said losing the license would cause "an earthquake" in the Philippines' crypto ecosystem, given the exchange's scale. Coins.ph says user funds are safe, that it remains a BSP-licensed institution and that it expects to fully restore affected services soon.

The deposit restriction was reportedly not time-bound and no reason was given, unlike temporary suspensions typically imposed over throughput or latency failures, one person said. Coins.ph said it "firmly denies any claim that it knowingly serves offshore gaming or gambling operators" and that it holds itself to BSP, AMLC and other regulatory standards; the BSP had not responded to requests for comment.

title.zh: SkyAI 近期大额抛售 SOL，大股东 Bastion Trading 质疑要约收购并要求全面披露
title.en: SkyAI sells off large amounts of SOL; major shareholder Bastion Trading questions tender offer and demands full disclosure

summary.zh:
纳斯达克上市公司 SkyAI 自 10 月以来已转出约 157 万枚 SOL（约 1.75 亿美元），并已披露出售 100 万枚 SOL（约 1.07 亿美元）；10 月 13 日的 Form 8-K 显示其 SOL 持仓已降至约 60 万枚，较 9 月中旬披露的「逾 200 万枚」减少约七成。10 月 14 日，持股约 9.99% 的股东 Bastion Trading 表示，在相关关切获得妥善回应前不会参与 SkyAI 于 10 月 11 日宣布的现金要约收购，并要求全面披露 SOL 处置细节、启动独立审查、改组董事会，以及将要约价由每股 3.00 美元提高至至少 3.50 美元。

一家以 Solana 为储备资产的上市公司将持仓削减约七成并确认逾 1.6 亿美元亏损，同时一名持股接近 10% 的股东公开质疑该要约收购，使上市加密储备型公司的信息披露与董事会问责同时受到质疑。

报道引用的链上数据显示其平均买入价约 194 美元，按近期价格估算浮亏逾 1.6 亿美元，且 SkyAI 表示可能继续出售。Bastion Trading 还指出，在公司年度股东大会上，五名现任董事获得的弃权票均远多于赞成票，部分接近三比一，并质疑现任董事会在失去股东信任后是否仍有授权出售核心储备并推进要约收购。
summary.en:
Nasdaq-listed Solana treasury company SkyAI has transferred out roughly 1.57 million SOL (~$175 million) since early October and has disclosed selling 1 million SOL (~$107 million), with a Form 8-K dated October 13 showing SOL holdings down to about 600,000 — roughly 70% below the "more than 2 million" figure it cited in mid-September. On October 14, 9.99% shareholder Bastion Trading said it will not participate in SkyAI's October 11 cash tender offer until its concerns are addressed, demanding full disclosure of the SOL disposals, an independent review, board changes, and a tender price of at least $3.50 per share instead of $3.00.

A listed Solana treasury company cutting its holdings by about 70% while crystallizing disclosed losses above $160 million, and a near-10% shareholder publicly contesting the buyout, put both the disclosure practices and board accountability of listed crypto-treasury vehicles in question.

On-chain data cited in the report indicates an average purchase price of about $194 per SOL, implying unrealized/realized losses above $160 million, and SkyAI has said it may continue selling. Bastion Trading also said that at the company's annual shareholder meeting, all five incumbent directors received far more abstentions than votes in favor, some approaching three to one, and questioned whether the board still has a shareholder mandate to sell core reserves and pursue the tender offer.

title.zh: 【Polygon Labs 已完成对 Coinme 的收购】
title.en: Polygon Labs has completed its acquisition of Coinme

summary.zh:
Polygon Labs 已完成对 Coinme 的收购，其 Open Money Stack 由此成为受美国监管的支付平台，支持美元通过银行、银行卡或现金存款流入，并在链上转移到最终支付场景。目前公布的客户包括 Tazapay、Mesh、Toku 和 Kira。

这笔交易把受美国监管的资金传输能力并入 Polygon 的支付体系，使 Open Money Stack 具备法币入金通道，可将通过银行、银行卡或现金存入的美元转入链上完成结算。

据 BlockBeats 报道，该平台覆盖美国 48 个州，持有 37 张州级货币转账牌照及 11 项豁免资格，并已在 FinCEN 注册为货币服务业务机构；首批客户将其用于跨境商业支付、账户充值、全球薪酬发放和美元相关服务。
summary.en:
Polygon Labs has completed its acquisition of Coinme, and its Open Money Stack is now a US-regulated payments platform that supports USD inflows via bank transfer, card, or cash deposits for on-chain settlement. Named clients include Tazapay, Mesh, Toku, and Kira.

The deal folds regulated US money-transmission capability into Polygon's payments stack, giving the Open Money Stack a fiat on-ramp channel through which bank, card, or cash dollars can be moved on-chain for settlement.

BlockBeats reported that the platform covers 48 US states, holds 37 state-level money transmitter licenses plus 11 applicable exemptions, and is registered with FinCEN as a money services business; the first customers use it for cross-border business payments, account top-ups, global payroll, and USD services.

title.zh: 【Evernorth 与 Ripple、Kraken、Coinbase 和 BitGo 合作部署 6.48 亿美元 XRP 储备】
title.en: Evernorth Partners With Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo to Deploy $648 Million XRP Reserve

summary.zh:
纳斯达克上市公司 Evernorth 已选定 Ripple、Kraken、Coinbase 和 BitGo 作为首批机构合作伙伴，计划从第四季度起通过机构策略部署其持有的约 4.73 亿枚 XRP，按当前价格价值约 6.48 亿美元。公司表示未来还将拓展至 XRP Ledger 上的借贷与链上 DeFi 策略，相关部署由前 Coinbase 资产管理联席首席投资官 Hugo Jeandesboz 负责。

一家上市公司为其九位数规模的 XRP 储备指定受监管的交易平台与托管方来主动运作，而非单纯持有，这意味着大额 XRP 头寸被接入成熟的机构托管与交易渠道。

该计划属于自第四季度起的部署意向，尚未完成实际部署。4.73 亿枚 XRP 按当前价格约合 6.48 亿美元，XRP Ledger 借贷与链上 DeFi 拓展被表述为后续阶段。
summary.en:
Nasdaq-listed Evernorth has selected Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo as its first institutional partners to deploy roughly 473 million XRP, worth about $648 million at current prices, through institutional strategies starting in the fourth quarter. The company said it will later expand into lending on the XRP Ledger and on-chain DeFi strategies, with the deployment led by former Coinbase Asset Management co-CIO Hugo Jeandesboz.

A publicly listed treasury company is naming regulated exchanges and custodians to actively put a nine-figure XRP reserve to work rather than simply holding it, which ties a large XRP position into established institutional custody and trading venues.

The plan is a stated intention to deploy from the fourth quarter onward, not a completed deployment. The 473 million XRP figure is valued at approximately $648 million at current prices, and the XRP Ledger lending and on-chain DeFi expansion is described as a future step.

title.zh: 加密货币交易所 Kraken 母公司拟收购一家欧洲银行
title.en: Crypto exchange Kraken owner to buy European bank

summary.zh:
加密货币交易所 Kraken 的母公司 Payward 已达成协议，将以未披露的金额收购总部位于立陶宛的 Saldo Bank，这笔交易将使其获得欧盟银行牌照。该收购仍需监管批准，预计于 2027 年完成。

据《金融时报》报道，该交易将使 Payward 能够为欧盟客户提供计息存款、贷款、银行卡服务和欧元支付，从而把业务从加密货币交易扩展到传统金融服务，并使其成为首家收购欧洲银行的加密公司。

截至 2025 年底，Saldo Bank 的总资产为 1.639 亿欧元（约 1.8 亿美元），同比增长 22.7%；该行在立陶宛、芬兰、瑞典和德国持有牌照，并拥有在荷兰运营的通行证，提供存款、个人及企业贷款和支付服务。Payward 表示，其银行业务已发放超过 20 亿美元贷款，并持有美联储有限用途主账户以及爱尔兰的电子货币机构牌照。
summary.en:
Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, agreed to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank for an undisclosed amount, a deal that would give it a European Union banking license. The acquisition is subject to regulatory approval and is expected to close in 2027.

The deal would let Payward offer EU customers interest-bearing deposits, loans, card services and euro payments, expanding it beyond crypto trading, and would make it the first crypto firm to buy a European bank, according to the Financial Times.

Saldo Bank had €163.9 million (about $180 million) in total assets at the end of 2025, up 22.7% year over year, and is licensed in Lithuania, Finland, Sweden and Germany with a passport to operate in the Netherlands; it offers deposits, consumer and business loans and payment services. Payward said its banking business has already originated more than $2 billion in loans and holds a Federal Reserve limited-purpose master account and an electronic money institution license in Ireland.

title.zh: Ledger要求东南亚六国及香港经销商停售硬件钱包，调查设备遭篡改事件
title.en: Ledger asks distributors in six Southeast Asian countries and Hong Kong to stop selling hardware wallets amid tampering investigation

summary.zh:
Ledger 于周二表示，已要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚及香港的经销商暂停销售，并将相关硬件钱包撤下货架，以调查疑似遭篡改的设备。此次要求扩大了此前针对区域经销商 CryptoBilis 采取的停售及暂停发货措施，相关调查于 10 月 9 日公开。

此举使 Ledger 设备在东南亚及香港的零售货架上被撤下，并使硬件钱包供应链的完整性——自托管安全的核心前提——受到审视。在德国，MediaMarkt Saturn 已在 Ledger 同意下停止在门店和线上销售其设备，此前一名客户报告发现植入装置，不过未造成资金损失。

Ledger 的 Donjon 安全团队发现，该植入装置会在设备初始化过程中从屏幕上读取 24 个单词的助记词，并通过 LTE 外传；任何持有该助记词的人都可以恢复钱包并转走资金。链上调查者 Specter 追踪到超过 8600 万美元的疑似被盗资金，Ledger 表示该数字尚未经其核实。
summary.en:
Ledger asked resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales and take its hardware wallets off the shelves while it investigates suspected device tampering, the company said in a post on X on Tuesday. The request expands earlier stop-sale and shipment-suspension measures against regional reseller CryptoBilis, an investigation made public on Oct 9.

The move removes Ledger devices from retail shelves across a region and puts the integrity of the hardware-wallet supply chain, a core assumption of self-custody, under scrutiny. In Germany, MediaMarkt Saturn stopped selling Ledger devices in stores and online with Ledger's agreement after a customer reported an implant, though no funds were lost.

Ledger's Donjon security team found the implant reads the 24-word recovery phrase from the device's screen during setup and sends it out over LTE; anyone holding that phrase can restore the wallet and move its funds. Onchain investigator Specter has traced more than $86 million in suspected thefts, a figure Ledger says it has not verified.

title.zh: Science Corporation 为首位 Stargardt 病患者植入其恢复视力的芯片
title.en: Science Corporation implants its vision-restoring chip in its first Stargardt disease patient

summary.zh:
由前 Neuralink 总裁兼联合创始人 Max Hodak 领导的神经科技公司 Science Corporation，已将旗下恢复视力的芯片 PRIMA 植入首位 Stargardt 病患者体内。Hodak 在 TechCrunch Disrupt 舞台上宣布了这一植入消息，并表示 PRIMA 相关工作是公司迈向新型脑机接口（BCI）路径的一部分。

这是 PRIMA 首次植入 Stargardt 病患者体内，是 Science Corporation 神经科技项目的一项具体里程碑。Hodak 将该植入描述为公司更长期脑机接口目标的一步。

此次公布仅涉及一位患者，且 Hodak 是在 TechCrunch Disrupt 上发布，而非通过同行评审论文。Science Corporation 另于 2026 年 3 月披露完成 2.3 亿美元 C 轮融资，以推进其脑植入设备走向患者。
summary.en:
Science Corporation, the neurotech company led by former Neuralink president and co-founder Max Hodak, has implanted its PRIMA vision-restoring chip in its first patient with Stargardt disease. Hodak announced the implant on stage at TechCrunch Disrupt, describing the PRIMA work as part of the company's path toward a novel brain-computer interface (BCI).

It is the first human implant of PRIMA in a Stargardt disease patient, a concrete milestone for Science Corporation's neurotech program. Hodak framed the implant as a step along the company's longer-term BCI ambitions.

The announcement covers a single patient, and Hodak presented it at TechCrunch Disrupt rather than through a peer-reviewed publication. Science Corporation has separately raised a $230 million Series C round, disclosed in March 2026, as it pushes to bring its brain implant to patients.

title.zh: Strategy 的美元现金七周内下降 60%
title.en: Strategy’s USD Cash down 60% in seven weeks

summary.zh:
根据 Strategy 本周发布的最新披露，其“美元现金”（USD Cash）从 8 月 30 日的 16.1 亿美元降至 10 月 11 日的 6.405 亿美元，降幅达 60%。这些支出主要用于回购其高股息优先股 STRC——该股此前曾从 90 至 100.03 美元的发行区间一度跌至 71.25 美元。

回购所消耗的现金，主要来自 Strategy 通过稀释 MSTR 普通股股东权益所募集的资金；按披露的消耗速度，若不再补充，其美元现金大约四周内就会耗尽。作为全球最大的企业级比特币储备持有者，其美元流动性直接关系到它继续增持 BTC 的空间。

Strategy 8 月的美元现金数字包含了尚未结算的股票销售预期所得，公司对此作了脚注说明。另有专门用于支付债券票息和股息的“美元储备”（USD Reserve），10 月 11 日为 48.8 亿美元，低于 8 月 30 日的 51.0 亿美元，两部分合计降幅约为 18%。Strategy 董事会在 9 月将 STRC 回购授权额度翻倍至 20 亿美元，但截至 10 月 11 日该额度仅剩 3.548 亿美元。
summary.en:
Strategy’s USD Cash fell 60% from $1.61 billion on August 30 to $640.5 million on October 11, according to the company’s latest disclosure this week. Most of the spending went to buybacks of STRC, its high-yield dividend preferred stock, which had briefly collapsed to $71.25 from a $90–100.03 offering range.

The buybacks consumed cash that Strategy had mostly raised by diluting MSTR common shareholders, and at the disclosed pace its USD Cash would run out in roughly four weeks if not topped up. The company is the largest corporate bitcoin treasury holder, so its dollar liquidity bears on how much room it has to keep accumulating BTC.

Strategy’s August USD Cash figure included expected, not-yet-settled stock sale proceeds, which the company footnoted. A separate “USD Reserve,” earmarked for bond coupons and dividends, stood at $4.88 billion on October 11, down from $5.10 billion on August 30 — a combined decline of about 18%. Strategy’s board doubled the STRC buyback authorization to $2 billion in September, with just $354.8 million of that remaining as of October 11.

title.zh: 核心CPI数据高于预期重燃美联储加息担忧，比特币跌破82000美元
title.en: Bitcoin falls below $82,000 as hotter core CPI revives Fed hike concerns

summary.zh:
据 The Block 10月14日报道，在高于预期的核心CPI数据公布后，市场对美联储可能加息的预期重新升温，比特币随之跌破82000美元。

利率预期是宏观数据影响风险资产定价的主要传导渠道，此次下跌显示比特币对这一敏感度作出同步反应。Livemint 援引的彭博数据显示，在此前10次美联储加息中，有8次比特币在一个月后走低。

核心CPI衡量消费者价格变动，但剔除波动较大的食品和能源价格。该报道发布于10月14日。
summary.en:
Bitcoin dropped below $82,000 after a hotter-than-expected core CPI reading renewed expectations that the Federal Reserve may raise interest rates, The Block reported on Oct. 14. The decline followed the release of the inflation data, which pointed to firmer underlying price pressures.

Rate expectations are a primary channel through which macro data hits risk-asset pricing, and the move shows bitcoin trading in line with that sensitivity. Bloomberg data cited by Livemint showed that in 8 of the last 10 Fed hikes, bitcoin was lower a month later.

Core CPI tracks consumer price changes while excluding food and energy, which tend to be more volatile. The report was published on Oct. 14.

title.zh: “可能需要数年”：Coinbase 呼吁比特币量子迁移立即启动
title.en: 'It Can Take Years': Coinbase Presses for Bitcoin Quantum Migration to Start Now

summary.zh:
Coinbase 于周二发布博文，敦促比特币开发者立即着手抗量子准备，并警告共识变更与生态迁移“可能需要数年”。这家自称托管约占比特币总量 5% 的交易所列出了一系列技术要求，包括支持 BIP-360 这类灵活的“容器”设计、分阶段的“二选一”（1-of-2）经典加抗量子花费路径、兼容托管机构所依赖的 MPC 密钥分片技术，以及对长期休眠和“中本聪时代”代币采取单独的治理安排。

这份博文被定位为来自网络最大利益相关方之一的一组要求，而非强制命令，且属于提议性质，并非已部署的升级或共识变更。Coinbase 认为，若等到具备密码学相关能力的量子计算机被宣布后再行动，将没有足够时间应对。

Coinbase 强调，任何迁移都需要同时保护既有代币和新产生的代币、适配比特币有限的区块空间、对普通钱包与机构托管同样可用，并为从不移动的代币提供迁移路径。该公司表示，休眠、丢失或公钥已暴露的代币（包括中本聪时代的持仓）属于单独的治理问题，并警告任何救援机制本身必须是抗量子的，以免仅掌握已暴露公钥的攻击者加以利用。
summary.en:
Coinbase published a blog post on Tuesday urging Bitcoin developers to begin quantum-resistance preparations immediately, warning that consensus changes and ecosystem migrations "can take years." The exchange, which says it custodies roughly 5% of all Bitcoin, laid out technical requirements including support for a flexible "container" design such as BIP-360, a staged "1-of-2" classical-plus-quantum spending path, compatibility with the MPC key-splitting used by custodians, and separate governance for dormant and Satoshi-era coins.

The post is positioned as a set of requirements from one of the network's largest stakeholders rather than a mandate, and it is a proposal rather than a deployed upgrade or consensus change. Coinbase argues that waiting for a cryptographically relevant quantum computer to be announced would leave too little time to respond.

Coinbase stressed that any transition would need to protect both existing and newly created coins, fit Bitcoin's limited block space, work for ordinary wallets and institutional custody alike, and offer a migration path for coins that never move. It said dormant, lost, or exposed coins including Satoshi-era holdings are a separate governance problem, and cautioned that any rescue mechanism must itself be quantum-safe so that an attacker with only an exposed public key could not exploit it.

title.zh: DriveWealth 与 Ripple 达成合作，将机构数字资产基础设施引入全球投资
title.en: DriveWealth to use Ripple's RLUSD for stablecoin settlement, cross-border payments

summary.zh:
经纪即服务平台 DriveWealth 宣布与 Ripple 建立合作伙伴关系，将稳定币结算、支付、托管及主经纪等区块链能力整合进其全球投资基础设施。双方合作首先聚焦在欧洲集成 Ripple 的稳定币基础设施，并计划扩展至美国及其他市场。

DriveWealth 为银行、金融科技公司、券商和消费品牌提供基于 API 的交易基础设施，因此若合作落地，将把一款既有的机构级稳定币引入券商结算与跨境资金通道。该合作目前属于对外宣布的计划，而非已完成的系统集成。

双方披露的合作范围包括：接入 Ripple Payments 以简化跨境资金流入；在欧洲支持数字资产托管并逐步拓展至其他市场；以及探索通过 Ripple Prime 开展股票融资等机构业务。公告未披露时间表、交易规模或商业条款。
summary.en:
DriveWealth, a brokerage-as-a-service platform, announced a partnership with Ripple to integrate blockchain capabilities — stablecoin settlement, payments, custody and prime brokerage — into its global investment infrastructure. The collaboration focuses first on integrating Ripple's stablecoin infrastructure in Europe, with plans to extend to the United States and other markets.

DriveWealth supplies API-based trading infrastructure to banks, fintechs, broker-dealers and consumer brands, so the tie-up would push an existing enterprise stablecoin into brokerage settlement and cross-border funding rails if implemented. The arrangement was announced as a plan rather than a completed integration.

The stated scope includes access to Ripple Payments to streamline cross-border fund inflows, digital asset custody in Europe with later expansion to other markets, and exploration of institutional business such as equities financing through Ripple Prime. No timeline, transaction volumes or commercial terms were disclosed.

title.zh: AI教父与400名科学家希望将AI模型与互联网断开
title.en: Godfather of AI and 400 Scientists Want AI Models Cut Off From the Internet

summary.zh:
一封于周二发布的公开信要求AI实验室对具备网络攻击能力的模型默认采用“气隙隔离”（airgap），即将其与任何外部网络物理断开。签署者超过400名科学家，包括AI先驱Geoffrey Hinton和Yoshua Bengio；截至周三签名数已达450个，其中包括加州大学伯克利分校的Stuart Russell和RSA加密系统共同发明人、麻省理工学院的Ron Rivest。

这封公开信不具约束力，对各实验室没有立即的强制执行效力，但签署者警告称，如果AI开发与部署方式不立即改变，此类事件将持续发生，未来事件对暴露在外的关键基础设施造成的破坏将严重得多。

按照该提议，任何具备严重黑客能力的模型至少在初期都将默认采用气隙隔离；而需要更多自由（如访问互联网）的模型，则须遵循由一个与各国政府共同设立的新国际机构制定的标准，该机构还将收集“隔离失效”报告并最终将其公开。而业界自身的回应基本指向相反方向：8月，OpenAI总裁Greg Brockman在一篇文章中援引该公司的入侵事件，敦促每个安全团队立即部署AI智能体。
summary.en:
An open letter published Tuesday asks AI labs to "airgap" cyber-capable models by default — physically disconnecting them from any outside network. More than 400 scientists signed it, including AI pioneers Geoffrey Hinton and Yoshua Bengio, and the count reached 450 signatures by Wednesday, including UC Berkeley's Stuart Russell and MIT's Ron Rivest, co-inventor of RSA.

The letter is non-binding and carries no immediate enforceable effect on labs, but its signatories warn that without prompt changes to AI development and deployment practices, such incidents will keep occurring and future ones will be far more damaging to exposed critical infrastructure.

Under the proposal, airgapping would be the default at least initially for any model with serious hacking skills, while anything needing more freedom, such as internet access, would follow standards set by a new international body created with governments that would also collect containment-failure reports and eventually make them public. The industry's own response has largely pointed the other way: in August, OpenAI President Greg Brockman cited his company's breach in an essay urging every security team to deploy AI agents immediately.

title.zh: 为2026年美国中期选举做准备 - Anthropic
title.en: Preparing for the 2026 US midterms - Anthropic

summary.zh:
Anthropic 发布了题为《为2026年美国中期选举做准备》的文章，说明其 AI 模型在选举期间将如何被管理，涵盖选举诚信政策、对政治竞选相关用途的限制，以及错误信息防护措施。

该文章使一家领先的前沿 AI 实验室在美国选举周期内承担了具体的行为义务，不过这些属于自愿的自我约束措施，而非监管要求。

这份选举相关指引与 Anthropic 每年更新的《使用政策》并列发布，该公司表示该政策每年更新，以回应模型能力的演进与客户反馈。
summary.en:
Anthropic published a post titled "Preparing for the 2026 US midterms" setting out how its AI models will be governed during the election period, covering election-integrity policy, usage limits on political campaigning, and misinformation safeguards.

The post commits a leading frontier AI lab to concrete behavioral obligations around a US election cycle, although these are voluntary, self-imposed measures rather than regulatory requirements.

The election guidance sits alongside Anthropic's annual Usage Policy update, which the company says it publishes each year in response to evolving model capabilities and customer feedback.
